reading_note: The teaching traces the entire arc of spiritual process measured by states (called "times"): from the divine purpose pre-existing in the Lord, through the calling forth of the matrix of spiritual life (Mother of Life) into the natural plane, the descent of divine truth (First Man) into the contest with self-love, the depicting/forming of the spiritual organism (Builder, Living Spirit, Ambassador, Christ-Splendor, Pillar of Glory), the long sojourn of truth and good through the five degrees of nature (worlds, elements, trees, fruits), and finally the dissolution of the natural cosmos in the conflagration of love, the binding of evil, and the return of all light to its kingdom. The single arc: states of the Lord's love going forth, descending, working through nature, and returning home with what they have rescued.
